{{Quote|Let me tell you something about Crimson Phoenix. This unit was designed to be the best. Do you hear me? THE BEST. I don't tolerate anything less from my pilots.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Ufwol]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Crimson Phoenix Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They operated out of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
